targetAuthority: Each target is stated by the feature scenarios listed with it. Where a scenario and this catalogue disagree, the scenario wins; correct the catalogue and host-sla.md together and bump both versions. An objective with no scenario yet derives from the governing document its target basis names; its scenarios belong to the probe capability's feature (host-sla.md section 11).

slos.title: API availability

target.basis: The hosted browser holds sfx-platform PLT-BROWSER-AVAILABILITY at 99.5% over 30 days and depends on this API for sign-in, sessions and runs, so the API holds at least the same. No measurement of the API origin exists yet.

sli.unit: one probe sample of one route in the anonymous route set, on the governed origin

routes.request: POST /sfx/v1/session, an identifier no principal has

sli.good: The expected status and error code, answered within request-answer-bound.
sli.bad: Timeout, connection failure, unexpected status or code, a 5xx from the host's own capacity (REQUEST_KERNEL_BUSY, a container start), or a named dependency failure without matching attribution evidence.
sli.excluded: A named refusal with independent attribution evidence that names the dependency's owner and matches the sample's route and time. A code alone is not attribution.

evidence: per-sample request, status, code and server time
host build identity of the serving image

measurement.method: A probe capability declared in the host's bundle, invoked by the operator through the installed CLI on every release and on a schedule; when the host cannot answer, the invoking client's failure is the observation (host-sla.md section 11).

slos.title: Explicit failure

target.basis: sfx-platform product-sla.md section 9 obliges sfx-api to refuse unavailable operations with a named code; content-delivery-boundary.v1 adds the responsible owner.

sli.unit: one observed failure of a request to the declared API
sli.good: Answered with a named uppercase code that names the unavailable operation, and whose named cause the record does not contradict.
sli.bad: A generic or blank error, a timeout with no code, a substituted result, or a named dependency failure when the dependency is shown healthy (2026-11-05: 503 IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE while identity answered).

evidence: the attribution evidence for the named cause

measurement.method: Probe-observed failures from the api-availability probe; acceptance and defect-reported failures recorded by hand under the measurement contract.

slos.title: Release integrity

target.basis: docs/signin-outage-2026-11-05.md: 'Every deploy should probe sign-in. A frontdoor probe passes while sign-in is down.'

sli.unit: one release transaction on the governed site: from setting SFX_API_IMAGE_DIGEST until the release probe set passes on the new digest or the previous digest serves again
sli.good: The new digest serves and passed the release probe set (every api-availability route, sign-in refusal through open-api-session included), with its host build identity retained; or the previous digest was restored.
sli.bad: Stranded: the site serves a digest that failed or skipped the release probe set and was not restored.

evidence: host build identity: source commit, image digest, bundle pin, kernel digest, host-files digest

measurement.method: Each deploy record under docs/ states its swap and probes; recorded by hand under the measurement contract.

sli.unit: one sample: 30 sequential requests alternating GET /sfx/v1/nope (404) and GET /sfx/v1/session without a credential (401), answered by warm request kernels on the governed origin; server time is time to first byte minus the TLS handshake, nearest-rank percentiles

measurement.method: Operator workstation samples recorded as summaries in docs/azure-test-*.md; per-request times are not retained.

slos.title: Request answer bound (SLA)

sli.good: Answered within 230 s of receipt: its kernel's answer, the declared busy response or the declared failure response.

slos.baseline: each request kernel's answer bound 198000 ms; a request waits at most the declared 30000 ms for a free kernel (sfx-api.config.json, declarations/25). The wait was 2 s until 2026-11-03, when it refused the Explorer's concurrent reads

measurement.method: The bounds are declared settings; no observation checks that requests are answered within them.

scenarios.scenario: No request outlives App Service's 230 s bound
The bounds of request-answer-bound and run-capacity are declared values
